referencePolicy: References were inspected by the coordinator for style calibration and faction-boundary review. Because every output is a brand-new subject, no local image is submitted as an edit target or generation input. The selected canonical record and exact masterDirection govern every visible feature.
promptCompilation: For each asset, the exact generation prompt is inputRole followed by two newline characters, commonDirection, two newline characters, and masterDirection. These fields are frozen before the first generation call. Any correction requires a separate immutable revision packet and a versioned candidate filename.
inputRole: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new original canonical named character. The accepted local masters were inspected only to calibrate production finish and faction boundaries; do not copy any existing face, pose, costume, anatomy or form-specific prop.
commonDirection: Asset type: canonical individual named-character production concept master for later 3D design. Render exactly one complete original League of Remaining Hands subject in polished stylized 3D dark-fantasy MMORPG production quality. Obey only the selected character's canonical record. Shared League language is mature wholly mortal anatomy unless the selected record explicitly names one exception; repaired civic workwear; rain-dark cloth, aged leather, ash-gray layers, restrained brass and practical apparatus; evidence of maintenance, responsibility and survival rather than aristocratic glamour. Keep Lucent ivory-gold cathedral armor, halos, wings and radiance out of this faction. Keep Charnel black-nacre anatomy, extra limbs, bodily apertures and gore out unless the selected record explicitly requires a non-gory exception. Three-quarter production view, centered, complete full-body silhouette with generous clearance. Portrait 1024 by 1536 composition. Flat near-black neutral opaque studio backdrop; cold raking studio light; ungraded measurement-friendly presentation. No environment, settlement, street, office, archive, workshop, court, carriage, engine room, floor, ground plane, terrain, pedestal, contact or cast floor shadow, unrelated extra creature or person, narrative scene, caption, UI, readable text, letter, numeral, rune, heraldry, real religious mark, logo, watermark, franchise resemblance, photobashed real person, glossy plastic, bright aura, cute proportions, gore, exposed entrails, baked checkerboard, transparency, or crop.

assets.name: Mara Quoin

canonical.role: Municipal locksmith and unrecognized heir to a noon-restored house
canonical.desire: Protect the present tenants without turning her inheritance into their eviction notice.
canonical.fear: That accepting her own history will give the dead deed more authority than the family now living there.
canonical.contradiction: She treats daily use as the only honest title while hiding the forged deed that once made the tenants' use legally possible.
canonical.secret: Mara falsified the deed that saved the current family and is the previous household's unrecognized daughter.
canonical.visualBrief: Locksmith in layered tenant coats; a different obsolete door hinge replaces each knuckle, with no heraldic title or weapon.

assets.masterDirection: Show exactly one complete mature mortal municipal locksmith, Mara Quoin, with one unobscured human face, two arms, two hands, two legs and two boots. Dress her in several visibly separate layered tenant coats: repaired, differently aged rain-dark civic garments with practical locksmith pockets and restrained old brass, never a uniform, title garment, priestly robe, armor or aristocratic coat. Both hands must be fully visible. Every visible finger knuckle and joint on both hands is replaced by its own small functional OBSOLETE DOOR HINGE; no two hinge replacements share the same leaf shape, pin, wear pattern or period construction. The hinges articulate her otherwise human fingers and do not become claws, keys, doors, extra digits or Charnel anatomy. Keep the hinge array readable and subordinate to her mortal silhouette. Her hands hold no weapon, deed, title, key-shaped weapon or heraldic object; at most one compact plain locksmith tool remains closed on the belt. Full coat layers, every hand joint and both boots stay inside black clearance. No house, doorway, tenant, deed page, readable mark, key ring, halo, wing, nacre, floor or scene.

assets.name: Kessa Pale

canonical.role: Census clerk whose separated shadow has different standing than her body
canonical.desire: Give absences representation without pretending each belongs to the nearest visible person.
canonical.fear: Discovering that her erased shadow held politics and loyalties she would now oppose.
canonical.contradiction: She demands auditable population totals while having counted erased shadows as dependants to divert food into an unregistered street.
canonical.secret: Kessa used the historic-erasure ledger to feed Nullstreet and cannot prove which recorded dependant was once her own shadow.
canonical.visualBrief: Ink-stained census clerk whose body casts no shadow; carries a blank roll that darkens around exclusions.

assets.masterDirection: Show exactly one complete mature mortal census clerk, Kessa Pale, with ordinary human anatomy, one unobscured face, two arms and hands, two legs and two boots. Dress her in repaired ink-stained civic clerk layers, practical rather than academic, priestly or ceremonial. Her fingertips, cuffs and a few workwear seams carry old matte ink stains. She carries EXACTLY ONE partly unfurled blank census roll made from tactile pale paper. The roll contains no writing, lines, grid, portrait, numeral, icon or seal. Instead, the paper itself darkens in restrained irregular ink-like borders around several completely clean blank excluded areas, making absence legible without forming any symbol or text. Her body casts NO external shadow at all: no silhouette behind her, no contact shadow below her, no independent shadow figure and no dark double, while normal cold raking form-shading remains on her body and clothes. Both hands and the entire roll stay visible and countable. Full roll ends, coat hem and boots remain inside black clearance. No desk, queue, street, ledger stack, moth, second roll, halo, nacre body, floor or scene.

canonical.contradiction: He demands that policy name who waits longer, but schedules his estranged son's street only while the boy sleeps.
canonical.secret: Hobb has preserved an unofficial stop for his son while denying that personal routes belong on the public docket.
canonical.visualBrief: Municipal driver in patched road leathers, permanently leaning into a wheel that is no longer attached.

assets.name: Gannet Triune

canonical.role: Survivor of a town whose three councils must agree before opening a well
canonical.desire: Preserve distributed veto without letting disagreement become fatal paralysis.
canonical.fear: That an authority will manufacture emergencies merely to bypass consent.
canonical.contradiction: He requires every continuity claim to survive three councils, but forged unanimity during a famine and saved his town.
canonical.secret: Gannet authored all three famine votes in different hands and still does not know whether the act was legitimate.
canonical.visualBrief: Civic clerk with three mismatched lever gloves and three council cords knotted at different tensions.

assets.masterDirection: Show exactly one complete mature mortal civic clerk, Gannet Triune, with one unobscured human face, exactly two ordinary arms and hands, two legs and two boots. Dress him in repaired layered civic work clothes with restrained aged leather and brass, no armor, robe, heraldry or council insignia. Show EXACTLY THREE and only three visibly mismatched practical LEVER GLOVES: one worn on his left hand, one worn on his right hand, and one empty third glove clipped separately to his belt with its vacant opening clearly visible. Each glove has a different lever-gripping construction and wear history, but no weapon, claw or extra hand. Show EXACTLY THREE and only three separate council cords routed across his upper body. Every cord is blank and non-symbolic, and each is tied in one visibly distinct knot under a clearly different physical tension: one taut straight cord, one moderately tensioned cord and one slack hanging cord. The three cords never braid or merge. Both worn gloves, empty third glove, all three knots and all three tension states must be simultaneously countable. Full cords, coat hem and boots stay inside black clearance. No third arm, well, council chamber, vote page, pen, readable mark, lever machine, halo, nacre, floor or scene.
